 Print CBSE Board exam 2027 timetable The Central Board of Secondary Education ( CBSE ) is expected to release the date sheet for the Class 10 and Class 12 board examinations 2027 soon. Students appearing for the 2026-27 academic session will be able to check the subject-wise examination schedule on the official website, cbse.gov.in, once it is released. The board examinations are expected to begin in February 2027. However, CBSE has not confirmed the date sheet release date in the information available. Students are advised to check the official website regularly for the latest announcements. The date sheet will help students plan their revision and prepare for each subject according to the examination schedule. Class 10 students will appear under the two-examination system, while Class 12 students will follow the schedule issued by the board. CBSE date sheet 2027 : How to download
 Once the timetable is released, students can follow these steps to download it. Visit the official website at cbse.gov.in.
 Open the main website.
 Look for the notification related to the Class 10 or Class 12 date sheet 2027.
 Click on the relevant link.
 The date sheet will open in PDF format.
 Download the file and save it for future reference.
 Students should check the official website for the correct date sheet for their respective classes. CBSE Class 10, 12 date sheet 2027: Details to check
 The date sheet PDF is expected to include important information about the board examinations. Students should check the following details after downloading it: Subject names and subject codes
 Examination dates and days
 Examination timings
 Important instructions for exam days
 Students should check the dates carefully and plan their revision accordingly. CBSE board exams 2027: What students can do while waiting
 While waiting for the date sheet, students can continue their preparation using the syllabus and sample question papers available on the CBSE academic website. Practising sample papers can help students understand the question pattern, manage their time and identify topics that need more revision. Students should also review the applicable passing criteria for their respective classes. As stated in the provided information, students generally need to secure at least 33% marks in each subject, subject to the board's assessment and passing rules. CBSE Class 10, 12 board exams 2027: Important updates
 CBSE has introduced changes to its examination and evaluation processes in recent years. The two-examination system for Class 10 gives students an opportunity to improve their performance, while on-screen marking supports the digital evaluation of Class 12 answer sheets. Students should follow official announcements for details about the examination schedule and any instructions applicable to the 2027 board examinations.
